data.name: Dhoni
data.gender_notes: Dhoni is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhanya’ meaning mountain. This name symbolizes strength, stability, and a solid foundation. In Hindu mythology, Dhoni is an epithet for Lord Shiva, known as the ‘Mountain of Mercy’. The name Dhoni carries the meaning “Mountain, Solid, Stable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhoni usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain, solid, stable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, stability, and prosperity. It is a powerful name that invokes the blessings of Lord Ganesha, the elephant-headed God of wisdom, strength, and good fortune.
data.etymology: Dhoni belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain, Solid, Stable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhoni total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Dhoni" originating from the Sanskrit word ‘dhanya’ in Hindu culture, holds significant importance in Indian society. Being associated with mountains and strength, this name signifies the courage and resilience of people, especially in adversity. Furthermore, the surname Dhoni has gained immense recognition in recent times, thanks to Mahendra Singh Dhoni, the former Indian cricket team captain, inspiring generations with his leadership skills and sportsmanship.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Dhoni" transcends beyond a personal moniker; it possesses profound spiritual significance. As a suffix of Lord Shiva, the Hindu God of destruction, regeneration, and transformation, Dhonis embody his ferocious and benevolent aspects. The name thus encourages spiritual growth, emphasizes endurance through difficult times, and symbolizes a deep connection to age-old traditions and values.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dhoni, meaning "he who nourishes," embodies the provider role in life. It symbolizes the selfless act of giving and fostering growth, reflecting the nurturing spirit within every individual.
